archive_layout: project files at archive root for direct overlay extraction
migration_revision_fix: 0020_overture_feed (18 characters), within PostgreSQL default alembic_version.version_num VARCHAR(32)

automatic_approval.default_safety_note: Disabled by default; existing explicit .env setting is respected.

overture_pipeline.ingestion_adapter: Scheduled daily STAC release detection; DuckDB queries public Places GeoParquet for England in place
overture_pipeline.admin_csv_upload: removed from normal admin workflow; legacy API retained for compatibility
overture_pipeline.geography_scope: England; broad bbox followed by official ONS county/unitary authority point-in-polygon validation
overture_pipeline.new_release_only: yes; daily STAC checks do not rescan an unchanged release
overture_pipeline.task_recovery: Persists Celery task ID, resumes unfinished scheduled import run on redelivery, batch progress metadata and structured logs
overture_pipeline.candidate_processing_query_fix: Apply run_id filter before order_by/limit; regression test added.
overture_pipeline.boundary_cache: Persistent named Docker volume; source, retrieval timestamp, schema version and SHA-256 validated; 30-day TTL
overture_pipeline.website_leads: Third-party URLs are retained as discovery provenance and never treated as first-party provider websites
overture_pipeline.enrichment_retries: Initial assessment plus at most three scheduled retries after 2, 7 and 21 days; excludes exceptions and exclusions
overture_pipeline.stale_run_recovery: Daily recovery after 24 hours: release stale candidate claims, resume pending work, close empty orphaned runs with audit events; never deletes history

tests.full_api_pytest: blocked during collection: packaging environment lacks psycopg, celery and redis dependencies

approval_policy.note: The 0.94 threshold is a configured gate, not a measured 94 percent accuracy claim.
